subject: Compliance add-ons: quote and term negotiation
messages:
From: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@veridianhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Compliance add-on pricing request for Veridian Health

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the team liked the latency/profile breakdown. We need a line-item firm quote for the following compliance items to include in our procurement packet:

- Audit log retention (30/90/365 day tiers) and export costs (per GB)
- KMS/HSM integration – per-HSM seat recurring cost and one-time onboarding
- Data residency (EU required for PHI subsets) — do you have an add-on surcharge?
- HIPAA certification/controls (are there incremental charges vs standard plan?)

Two asks: can you provide a short pricing schedule and any SOC2 evidence (bridge letter or report) we can share with our security team? Our procurement timeline is tight — ideally a signed PO by early December. Also let us know any discount you're willing to offer with a 36-month commit or Enterprise annual billing.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Lewis
Head of Security & Compliance
Veridian Health
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@veridianhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on pricing request for Veridian Health

Sam — thanks, appreciate the clarity on timeline. Draft pricing and evidence attached (rdw-compliance-pricing-20261122.pdf; soc2-bridge-letter.pdf; residency-terms.docx). Summary below — happy to walk through on a 30-minute call tomorrow:

- Audit logs:
  * 30 days: included in Enterprise bundle
  * 90 days: $0.12/GB/month for retained storage and $0.02/GB export fee
  * 365 days: $0.20/GB/month and $0.03/GB export fee
  * Indexed search / forensic export support: $1,200/month optional add-on

- KMS / HSM:
  * KMS integration (BYOK) – no monthly fee, one-time setup $2,500
  * HSM-seats (FIPS/HSM-backed key wraps): $3,200/month per HSM instance (includes key rotation tooling). We can add per-HSM SLA.
  * HSM provisioning lead time: typically 2–4 weeks (onboarding).

- Data residency:
  * EU residency (HIPAA workloads): add-on 18% surcharge on token costs + dedicated region routing; compatible with on-prem/private deployments.

- HIPAA add-on:
  * Business associate agreement (BAA): no incremental recurring fee for Enterprise plan; professional services for implementation available at market rates.

Concession: preliminary pricing assumes annual billing. For a 36-month commit we can offer a 15% discount across compliance add-ons (not including third-party HSM manufacturer fees).

Attachments: rdw-compliance-pricing-20261122.pdf, soc2-bridge-letter.pdf, residency-terms.docx

Proposed next step: 30-min call Thursday to confirm volumes and I'll follow up with a revised quote and DocuSign link.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Compliance add-on pricing request for Veridian Health

Markus / Monica — forwarding Veridian's ask. Key points: they want firm line items for audit logs, HSM seats, EU residency for PHI, and confirmation of SOC2 artifacts. My initial pricing is attached and I proposed 15% off for 36-month commit.

Questions:
- Monica, can you confirm we can reduce the HSM list price if we absorb some of the managed key rotation effort? Would your team be comfortable authorizing a temporary concession (first 3 months free / reduced onboarding)?
- Markus, Veridian is likely to ask for a lower audit-log export rate and a PO/POC timeline; how aggressive can we be on onboarding fee (currently $2.5k)?

I also attached a quick calc (pricing-calculation.xlsx) that shows impact vs. our TCV targets. If we offer any concessions, we should tie them to an annual prepay or a committed seat count.

-Steph
From: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@veridianhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@veridianhealth.com>, procurement@veridianhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-23T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on pricing request for Veridian Health

Stephanie — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups after a security review:

- HSM seats: $3.2k/mo per HSM is higher than expected for our volume. Would you consider a tiered price (e.g., $2.5k for the first 3 seats, then $1.8k for incremental seats) or a promotional period where the first 3 months are waived?
- Audit logs: can you cap the export costs or offer a monthly cap for forensic exports? Our legal ops prefer predictable ceilings.
- Residency: confirmed — we need EU processing for PHI slices and will require that those tokens never leave the EU cluster. Also need a written escalation path if data routing fails.
- Procurement: they asked if you can accept a 12-month PO net-30 today with an option to extend to 36 months at renewal (details in procurement@veridianhealth.com).

Finally, procurement asked for a DocuSign-ready quote + SOC2 artifacts. If you can provide a revised quote by Wednesday EOD, we can escalate to legal and procurement for an expedited PO.

Thanks,
Sam
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lewis <sam.lewis@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@veridianhealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on pricing request for Veridian Health — revised offer

Sam — appreciate the feedback. We've discussed internally and can do the following revised terms (see attached rdw-revised-quote-20261124.pdf and DocuSign link):

- HSM seats:
  * Revised: $2,500/month for first 3 HSMs, $1,900/month for incremental seats beyond 3 (applies to annual prepay or 36-month commit)
  * Promotional concession: first 3 months waived on annual prepay or any multi-year commit (to help with pilot).

- Audit logs:
  * Tiered retained storage rates as previous but add an export cap option: $2,500/month cap for unlimited export up to 5 TB; overage at $0.015/GB.
  * Forensic/search add-on remains $1,200/month.

- Residency & SLA:
  * EU PHI routing guarantee + written escalation matrix; 99.9% regional availability SLA for residency cluster with standard service credits on breach.

- Fees & discounts:
  * One-time onboarding fee reduced to $7,500 (from $2,500 described earlier — note: we absorbed some professional services to speed onboarding)
  * Compliance bundle discount: 15% on listed compliance add-on charges for 36-month commit; 10% for 12-month annual prepay.

Next steps: I can generate a DocuSign-ready quote if you confirm: (a) expected HSM seat count for pilot, (b) whether procurement will do a 12-mo PO now vs. waiting for 36-mo commit, and (c) acceptance of the export cap option. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/r/abc123-rdw-quote

Attachments: rdw-revised-quote-20261124.pdf

If procurement wants the 12-month PO with an option to extend, Finance will require the PO to include an amendment clause confirming pricing for the extension period (we can draft that). Happy to hop on a quick call with procurement and legal this week.

Best,
Stephanie
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Compliance add-on pricing request for Veridian Health — internal confirmation

Steph / Markus — I reviewed the concessions. Security is comfortable with the revised HSM tiering and the 3-month promotional waiver so long as: (1) the customer signs the implementation scope and (2) we include an SLA-backed incident escalation for the EU residency cluster. I also confirmed SOC2 bridge letter is fine to share with procurement (attached earlier by Stephanie).

Action items I can take on:
- Draft the residency escalation matrix for inclusion in the quote (should be done by EOD tomorrow).
- Coordinate with Legal on the amendment language for a 12mo PO -> 36mo extension.

Markus — please proceed to prepare the DocuSign quote with the revised numbers; tag Finance to review onboarding fee write-down and create renewal calendar. If procurement pushes back, offer the 10% 12-month prepay discount vs. the 15% 36-month commit.

-Monica
Security Engineering Manager — Redwood Inference
